text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia celebrates the African Children Day.
- The state has invested in infrastructures in the northwestern region to facilitate the development of the tourism sector. It is up to the private sector now to promote activities there.
- Works at "Erraml" dam that covers 1.300 hectares in the region of Zaghouan expected to end by 1998.
- Handicrafts sector represents three per cent of Tunisia's GDP. It employs some 220,000 people or nine percent of the employed population.
- Trade volume in the Tunisian southeastern port of Gabes rose by 19 percent during the first three months of 1997 compared with the same period of 1996.
